inputs.name: RateLimitService.constructor.store
inputs.description: Adapter backed by host-object storage for rate-window records. rate(bucket) returns the current record or undefined, and saveRate(bucket, record) persists the updated record so windows outlive service memory.

inputs.name: RateLimitService.hit.bucket
inputs.description: Bucket key for the per-host-object fixed-window counter that this hit reads and may update; accepted values are connect and pairing.

inputs.name: RateLimitService.hit.limit
inputs.description: Maximum hit count for this bucket during one relayConfig.rateWindowMs window. When an unexpired record already has count >= limit, this method returns false without saving; the number is not validated.

outputs.name: RateLimitService.hit
outputs.description: Indicates whether this hit was accepted: true after an increment is saved, false when the active window has already reached the supplied limit.
